title: When the Uniform Turns
author: Quentin Villalobos
blurb: Lior Quintana, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
